The path /tmp/... — the working directory is a WSL UNC path. The filesystem backend resolves paths. /tmp might be the Linux tmp inside WSL. Let me just try write with the literal path.

Note the file policy: workspace is \\wsl.localhost\debian-u8-1\home\g, but "Some platform temporary areas may also be writable." /tmp may be writable. Let's try.

写入和读回都已完成，全程只用了 write 和 read 两个工具，没有调用 shell。

操作成功，内容与预期一致。
